request: Do I really need another skirt for class this fall? Pick whichever fitting one costs the least, please. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Only show me something you've actually got on hand, not just listed on a website somewhere (I've been burned before). It's gotta be a skirt, and the style's got to be wrap (I'll double-check, don't you worry). Nothing over 475 cts, y'all (every penny counts when you're climbing out of student loan hill, bless my heart). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). Probably not, but my one good one finally gave out (bless it), and I'd like something new before the semester trail gets steep.
